digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface and janitor integration
propositions: rebar metrics command output and registry are not consulted by rebar-janitor during Discovery phase, leaving measured trends and historical code-health data unused as evidence
rebar metrics surfaces are not documented in discoverable project docs, making it difficult for agents and contributors to find and understand the available metrics

janitor Discovery guidance should instruct calling `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` and citing registered code-health-lens metric values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as temporal evidence

project documentation (user-guide.md, AGENTS.md, reuse-surface.md) must reference the metrics subsystem and explain the four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and unavailable state
